title: Decisions and questions edited in Simple
subtitle: Every field of a decision and of a PRD's open question can be changed, added, withdrawn and deleted on Simple's Decisions page; an owner changes, an approver who is not the decider proposes, a viewer reads.

decisions.name: Decisions edited in Simple
decisions.question: How does a person edit, reassign, withdraw and propose a decision in Simple?
decisions.common: Open decisions (Outside meetings and beside their meeting) get every field Detailed's inspector has: title, question, context, options, review day, and who decides; Reassign (owners only); a new decision. Withdraw is the 'not now': the decision stays in the history, with Undo. Delete sends it to Settings > Trash, where it can be restored (a toast offers Undo). An owner changes; an approver who is not the decider proposes a change to the decider; a viewer reads. What each person may do comes from can() and the decision's own can_edit, can_withdraw and can_reassign, as in Detailed's inspector. Decided ones stay as they are.

proposals.name: Row menu
proposals.what: A ⋯ button at the end of each open decision's row opens Edit, Reassign, Withdraw and Delete, under the button. Edit unfolds the whole form under the row; Reassign a person list; Withdraw a one-line confirm; Delete sends it to Settings > Trash with Undo. + New decision at the top opens a form above the lists, its decider picked in it.
proposals.plus: Familiar; the row stays in its list and nothing covers the page; one control per row.
proposals.cost: The form pushes the rest of the list down, far for a long decision (hard case); on a phone it fills the screen inside the list; the menu hides what can be done until opened.

proposals.name: Decision sheet
proposals.what: A decision's title (underlined) opens its sheet, the same side sheet (a bottom sheet on a phone) the feature panel uses: every field, the decider with Reassign, Edit, Withdraw and Delete at its foot. + New decision opens the same sheet, with Pick for its decider. The list itself does not change.
proposals.why: It matches Simple's one-panel rule for features: a person learns one way to read and change an item, the list keeps its place while the sheet scrolls a long decision, and the phone gets the bottom sheet it already knows. Questions use the same sheet (the question sheet).
proposals.plus: One place for every field, long or short; the list never jumps; the same pattern as the feature panel and the questions.
proposals.cost: One more click to see the details; the sheet covers part of the page at 1440 (the list stays visible beside it at 1512).

proposals.name: Edit in place
proposals.what: A chevron on each open decision shows all its fields under the title, each with its own Edit that turns just that field into an input. The decider's name is a link to reassign; Withdraw and Delete end the open row. A New decision line at the foot of the list adds one by its title, its decider picked beside it.
proposals.plus: No dialog or sheet: what you read is what you change, one field at a time; adding is one line.
proposals.cost: Many small Edit links on every open row; a long decision fills the list (hard case); a new decision starts with only a title, its other fields filled later; no single Save for several changes.

decisions.name: Questions edited in Simple
decisions.question: How does a person add, edit and withdraw a PRD's open question in Simple?
decisions.common: A question's text, the PRD's recommendation and its other answers can be changed; a question can be added to a PRD. Withdraw is the 'not now': the question stays in the PRD's history, with Undo. Delete sends it to Settings > Trash, where it can be restored (a toast offers Undo). An owner changes (so does the question's decider); an approver who is not the decider proposes a change to the decider; a viewer reads. Deciding and naming a decider stay as today. The same question row is used on Home, so what a proposal adds there shows on Home too.

proposals.name: In the row
proposals.what: A ⋯ beside Ask Oracle on each question opens Edit, Withdraw and Delete. Edit turns the row into fields (text, recommendation, other answers) with Save; an Ask a question line under the list adds one, its PRD picked beside it.
proposals.plus: Changes happen where the question is read; adding is one line under the list.
proposals.cost: The form shares the row with the action column, so it is narrow; a long question makes a very tall row (hard case); a fourth control on every row.

proposals.name: Question sheet
proposals.what: A question's title (underlined) opens its sheet, the same one decisions use (the decision sheet): the recommendation, other answers and decider, with Edit, Withdraw and Delete at its foot. + Ask a question at the top of Waiting for you opens the same sheet, with its PRD to pick.
proposals.why: Same sheet as decisions, so questions and decisions are changed the same way; the row keeps today's buttons for deciding, so nothing in the List changes for people who only decide; long questions scroll inside the sheet.
proposals.plus: Rows stay as they are; one place for every field; works the same on a phone (bottom sheet).
proposals.cost: One more click to edit; the sheet covers part of the list while open.

proposals.name: Edit mode
proposals.what: An Edit questions button at the top of Waiting for you switches the whole list into fields at once, each question with its own Withdraw and Delete and an Ask a question line at the end; Done editing goes back.
proposals.plus: Fast for tidying many questions in one go; clear when you are editing and when you are not.
proposals.cost: With 21 questions the page becomes a long form (hard case); deciding is hidden while editing; a mode people must remember to leave.
